[Download the PDF edition](../breeder-guide.pdf) | [Download the Word edition](../breeder-guide.html)

```{r guide-content, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
guide_name <- "HapBlockR_Breeder_Guide.md"
guide_path <- system.file("guide", guide_name, package = "HapBlockR")

if (!nzchar(guide_path)) {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path("..", "inst", "guide", guide_name),
    file.path("inst", "guide", guide_name)
  )
  guide_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1L]
}

if (!length(guide_path) || is.na(guide_path) || !file.exists(guide_path)) {
  stop("Cannot locate the maintained Breeder's Guide source.", call. = FALSE)
}

guide <- readLines(guide_path, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
if (length(guide) && grepl("^# ", guide[[1L]])) {
  guide <- guide[-1L]
}
cat(paste(guide, collapse = "\n"))
```
